evidence.quote: our assessment is that the most recent data have further strengthened the case for increasing the target range for the federal funds rate.
it is my view that the labor market is close to full employment.
PCE inflation can be expected to rise further toward our 2 percent target, supported by higher core PCE inflation, which ran at a 1.7 percent pace in September.
Overall, I expect GDP growth to continue at a moderate pace, supported by household spending, renewed business investment, and the waning effects of past dollar appreciation on export growth.
as we approach and perhaps to some extent exceed our employment and inflation targets.
